name: proxy-statement
description: Drafts a SEC Regulation 14A / Rule 14a-3 compliant annual meeting proxy statement (DEF 14A) covering notice, governance, executive compensation, related-party transactions, shareholder proposals, and voting procedures. Use when preparing proxy materials, annual meeting notices, or shareholder vote disclosures. Trigger: proxy statement, DEF 14A, annual meeting, proxy solicitation, say-on-pay, auditor ratification, Regulation 14A, Rule 14a-3.
